System, permissions and connection readiness
Get to know your head unit before connecting
The system did not provide a reliable result. Export logs for unavailable checks.
Android version
Meets the minimum Android 9 / API 28 version.
Below the minimum Android 9 version.
Processor and native components
Native components are packaged for this processor. Hardware access still needs a connection test.
Required native components were not found for this processor. Use the complete APK.
Selected video format
A decoder is advertised for this format. Resolution, frame rate and stability need a projection test.
No decoder is advertised for the selected format. Review display settings.
Local authentication component
Local materials are readable and the key matches the certificate. iPhone acceptance has not been tested.
Local authentication is unavailable. Export logs to check the installation.
Microphone permission
Permission granted. Siri and call recording still need a connection test.
Permission is missing for Siri and calls. This does not mean all CarPlay functions are unavailable.
Projection and audio
Connect to verify video, touch, music, calls and sustained playback. This check cannot diagnose playback pauses.
USB host capability
USB host support is declared. The vehicle port and cable still need a physical test.
USB host capability is unavailable to the app, so this interface cannot discover an iPhone.
USB device detection
An Apple USB device is attached. This does not yet confirm a working CarPlay channel.
No Apple USB device was found. Connect it through a data-capable port and check again.
USB access consent
The app has access to an attached Apple USB device.
Start a USB connection and allow access in the head unit prompt.
Wired tunnel consent
The app is authorized to create its local VPN tunnel. This does not route iPhone internet through the head unit.
Local tunnel consent is checked when starting USB. This check does not call VPN consent APIs or affect an existing VPN.
iPhone USB handshake
Trust, USB mode switching, the data tunnel and authentication require a real wired connection.
Wi-Fi module
The system exposes a Wi-Fi service. Hotspot operation needs a connection test.
No usable Wi-Fi service is exposed to the app.
Bluetooth module
The Android Bluetooth adapter is accessible. Pairing alone does not establish CarPlay.
The Android Bluetooth adapter is unavailable to the app, even if the vehicle has its own Bluetooth interface.
Bluetooth access
Required permission granted.
Allow nearby device access in app permissions.
Bluetooth state
Bluetooth is enabled for connection setup.
Enable Bluetooth in the head unit settings.
A connection session exists. The 2.4 GHz handoff may intentionally disable Bluetooth; leave its state unchanged.
Selected iPhone
The selected phone is present in the Android pairing list.
No selected, paired iPhone was found. Pair and select it on the connection page.
Location access
This Android wireless path requires precise location permission to read Wi-Fi information.
System location switch
System location is on, meeting this hotspot prerequisite.
Automatic hotspot creation requires system location to be enabled.
Automatic hotspot mode
The app includes a hotspot path for this Android version. Actual permission to start it remains unverified.
This Android version has no enabled automatic hotspot path. Choose the car hotspot on the connection page.
Existing hotspot use
No active system hotspot was reported.
The system hotspot is on and may block a temporary hotspot. Turn it off or use car hotspot mode.
Car hotspot configuration
Valid hotspot settings are saved. Their match with the real hotspot needs a connection test.
Car hotspot mode is selected, but its name or password is incomplete.
Car hotspot switch
The system reports an active hotspot. Its interface, band and channel still need verification.
The system reports the hotspot is off. Enable it in the vehicle settings.
Hotspot and wireless handoff
The AP interface, live channel, Bluetooth data path and iPhone consent/authentication need a wireless connection. This check never toggles radios.
PHONE CONNECTIVITY
Everything familiar. Ready for the drive.
Unlock your iPhone and choose a connection.
